hypothesis_summary: The yourls_add_new_link function exhibits high cognitive complexity due to conflating URL validation, concurrency checks, duplicate detection, title extraction, and database persistence into a single monolithic routine. Hypothesis: Extracting title fetching and duplicate checking into separate composable functions will decrease the module's cognitive load without altering the core shortening pipeline's deterministic behavior, improving maintainability and testability.
justification_or_plan: 1. Extract URL validation and sanitization into yourls_validate_and_sanitize_url(). 2. Extract title fetching logic into yourls_fetch_remote_title(). 3. Extract duplicate checking into yourls_check_duplicate_url(). 4. Refactor yourls_add_new_link() to compose these new functions. 5. Verify against formal constraints and test suite.
